g.text: YouTube Top-K Videos — HLD Revision Notes

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Ingestion: Kafka ViewEvent → Consumer → PostgreSQL counter per video.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - All-time Top-K: Index on views; query ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT K.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Time windows: Store counts per video per hour; aggregate with SUM +

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Problem: Massive DB writes + expensive scans for time-window queries.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Redis cache: Store precomputed Top-K results.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Cron job: Periodically calculates Top-K and refreshes cache.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Benefit: Most reads avoid DB queries.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Trade-off: Results may be slightly stale; monitor cron failures.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Sharding: Partition Kafka and DB by videoId; consumers write to separate

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Global Top-K: Fetch Top-K from each shard → merge results.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Batching: Use Flink to aggregate multiple views per video before DB writes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Result: Fewer writes and fewer DB shards needed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Problem: Scan billions of rows → aggregate counts → sort → very expensive.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option A — Rollups: Aggregate hourly counts into daily/monthly counts.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option B — Precomputed windows: Maintain separate tables for LastHour,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: LastDay, LastMonth, AllTime, indexed by views.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option C — Flink: Maintain distributed state, calculate Top-K continuously,

g.text: - Every minute: New views added − expired views removed.

g.text: - Keep minute-level counts to calculate decrements.

g.text: - Trade-off: More DB updates and storage.

g.text: - Keep a bounded Top-K candidate list/heap (max K = 1,000).
